Property.Name: apiBaseUrl
Property.Label: FVG Base URL
Property.Description: Base URL of the Falcon Vision Gateway (e.g. http://192.168.1.100). No trailing slash.

Property.Name: signId
Property.Label: Sign ID
Property.Description: FVG sign ID to display. Place additional widgets to show more signs.

Property.Name: apiKey
Property.Label: API Key
Property.Description: Optional value sent as the X-API-KEY header for FVG signs.read permission. Leave blank if no auth.

Property.Name: clientId
Property.Label: Client ID
Property.Description: Value sent as the X-Client-Id header. Set a unique value per placement (e.g. watchfire-carmel-1) for FVG heartbeat matching, or leave as watchfiresigns.

Property.Name: showName
Property.Label: Sign Name
Property.Description: Show or hide the sign name. Choose Hide for a count-only display.

Property.Name: showValue
Property.Label: Sign Count
Property.Description: Show or hide the sign count. Choose Hide for a name-only display.

Property.Name: textFont
Property.Label: Text Font
Property.Options: Watchfire Regular,Watchfire Regular Bold,WF Krasivyi Regular,WF Krasivyi Bold,WF Faceplate Regular,WF Faceplate Bold,-,Cabin,Cabin Bold,Cabin Medium,Cabin SemiBold,Chivo Bold,Cooper Hewitt Bold,Cooper Hewitt Semibold,Dosis Bold,Dosis Extra Bold,Encode Sans Black,League Spartan Bold,Montserrat Extra Bold,Roboto Black,Roboto Bold,Roboto Mono,Roboto Mono Medium,Work Sans Bold

Property.Name: nameColor
Property.Label: Name Color
Property.Description: Color of the sign name text

Property.Name: valueColor
Property.Label: Count Color
Property.Description: Color of the sign count text

Property.Name: alertColor
Property.Label: Alert Color
Property.Description: Color used for the count when it matches the Alert Values pattern

Property.Name: alertRegex
Property.Label: Alert Values
Property.Description: Case-insensitive regular expression. Counts that match display in the Alert Color. Leave blank to disable.

Property.Name: pollIntervalMs
Property.Label: Poll Interval (ms)
Property.Description: How often to query the FVG API for new values (100-60000)

Property.Name: offlineDelaySeconds
Property.Label: Offline Delay (s)
Property.Description: Seconds of continuous failed polls before the count switches to --. The last good count stays up during the delay (0-300).
